items.q: The best marker to estimate GFR is:
items.exp: Creatinine: best marker to estimate GFR. (Book p735)

items.q: Fill up: Creatinine is produced in muscle from ______.
items.exp: Produced in muscle from creatine; ↓ when muscle mass is reduced (eg: amputation). (Book p735)

items.q: Serum creatinine falls when muscle mass is reduced; the book's example is:
items.exp: ↓ sed when muscle mass reduced (eg: amputation). (Book p735)

items.q: Which of the following statements about creatinine in pregnancy is TRUE?
opts: Pregnancy raises the normal creatinine range to 1.5–2 mg/dL
Creatinine cannot be measured in pregnancy
Pregnancy is the only condition where high creatinine values are significant independently
Creatinine values lose all significance in pregnancy
items.exp: Pregnancy: only condition where high creatinine values are significant independently (normal 0.3–0.6 mg/dL). (Book p735)

items.q: The normal creatinine range quoted for pregnancy is:
Creatinine is described as a molecule of:
items.exp: Creatinine = 113 kDa molecule (cystatin C is the 13 kDa protein). (Book p735)
